basis: Names of explicitly supplied spatial bands and schema roles only; no rectangle overlaps, source strings, clocks, source order or count optimization used. Does not assert that band membership agrees for individual records.

excluded_bands.external: Open extra-figure or margin arrangement, not supplied closed circular band.
excluded_bands.central: Central/local regions are not a supplied cyclic label band.

cycle_policy.representation: Coarse short regions only. Finer split alternatives retained and compared but not selected as a certified cyclic unit system.
cycle_policy.order: Use image short_zone_clockwise_order_from_upward_ray; derive guided box-center angle clockwise from upward ray about image working_center_xy. Do not use source clocks or transcription order.
cycle_policy.eligibility: All declared records of the same band on both sides must have non-null boxes, equal nonzero count, and globally mutual-single-positive coarse candidate mapping fully confined to that band; image supplied order must enumerate every band region exactly once; no tied guided center direction. Otherwise not computed.
cycle_policy.rotation: If eligible, list all rotations that preserve the complete cyclic sequence of matched IDs; no textual phase, reversal, historical start or inter-ring connection.

ring_policy: Enumerate every Cc against every image continuous-ring outer envelope and, separately, every inner-envelope rectangle. Never infer annular ink agreement from nested disk intersections. No ring matching by closest size.
object_policy: All image figure compounds retained. Guided descriptive object_candidates lack rectangles in every panel; no object Cartesian comparison or zero-object claim.
alternative_policy: Keep NA working boxes as NA. Every explicit guided candidate_regions rectangle receives its own separate complete Cartesian comparisons against coarse and finer image rosters; never substitute it into primary results or choose a best alternative.
